## M8 — Active: verified original PC baseline

A reproducible native original-game baseline with explicit fidelity and usability evidence, not just startup.

Dependencies: M7.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PC06 | Separate Original and Enhanced launch policies | Done | Default Original refuses packs before runtime/disc access; Enhanced explicitly permits implemented packs; synthetic tests and native original/enhanced/restoration controls, requested-vs-actual receipt provenance. Not full accuracy or settings UI. |
| OB01 | Resolve or precisely bound retail translation diagnostics | In progress | Investigate the retained generation error and warnings; document affected paths and observed consequences without guessed stubs or suppression. Current emitted-body dead-tail classification is bounded by compiler/entry/negative controls; preserve the reported error and investigate remaining warnings/guest coverage separately. |
| OB02 | Prove genuine in-game persistence | In progress | Actual game Save, process closure and new-process Load with state/progression evidence; runtime snapshots and card-file presence do not qualify. |
| OB03 | Verify physical input and audible audio | Planned | Owner/hardware round trips for keyboard and controller, mapping/persistence and audible output; distinguish scripted/headless tests. |
| OB04 | Validate representative original behavior | Planned | Named-reference comparisons for scenes, combat timings/AI/camera, cutscenes, bosses and transitions; retain failures and per-scenario coverage. |
| OB05 | Organize human campaign validation | Planned | Legitimate saves and human playthrough checklist, progression/save regression matrix; no autonomous level-beating loops or untested full-game claim. |
| PC07 | Remove inherited timeout and preserve persistent controls | Done | Explicit unlimited normal-launch intent; bounded hidden policy retained. Workspace controls with byte-copy adoption/reuse and isolated diagnostics; guarded native UI edit/save/new-process reload; timer120s/explicit-zero controls; public220s scene regression and unchanged originals. No hardware/game-save claim. |
| OB06 | Bound retained diagnostic with native negative controls | Done | Retained original error/counter and unchanged native build; exact generated C++ body/entry audit and compiler reachability checks under both return modes. Three original ELF controls and four native return/throw outcomes; clean committed public recipe and portable synthetic CI. Not full guest-PC/ISA/game coverage. |

## M9 — Active architecture: maintainable, reversible PC enhancements

Keep original behavior as a control; readable original host/function replacements survive generation and tested upstream updates.

Dependencies: M8.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RM01 | Map one verifiable function/subsystem boundary | Planned | Record provenance and validate one identity/ABI/overlay lifetime against actual runtime evidence; static name/address candidates alone do not qualify. |
| RM02 | Introduce one readable behavior-preserving replacement | Planned | Version original replacement source outside generated outputs; original/replacement non-regression, fallback and regeneration controls. |
| RM03 | Audit and expose coherent PC settings | In progress | Reuse existing upstream options; implement validated persistent settings/menu and reversible capabilities without claiming unimplemented features. |
| PC04 | Verify another named resource and restoration | Planned | A second named resource/scene, original authored payload, exact supported storage contract and actual enabled/disabled/fallback controls; no guessed offsets or expanded format claims. |
| PC05 | Prove a size-aware HD asset upload boundary | Planned | Specify resource-to-host upload ownership; import an original larger texture without republishing game assets, actually render and compare from one viewpoint. Same-size replacement is not acceptance. |
| RM04 | Validate widescreen | Planned | Projection/FOV, HUD, cinematics and culling verified against 4:3 controls; no image stretching. |
| RM05 | Prove simulation-safe presentation cadence changes | Planned | Separate rendering cadence from simulation; verify animation, timers, physics, hit windows and AI at multiple cadences before FPS unlock claims. |
| RM06 | Improve renderer/material/light control incrementally | Planned | Document resource-to-render path and material/light inputs; prove each original/enhanced change at fixed viewpoints. Whole-engine migration requires a reproduced justification. |
| RM07 | Trial upstream updates without losing extensions | Planned | Separate fresh pinned workspace, reviewed dependencies/preimages, build and relevant behavior/profile/pack regression controls before repinning. |

## M1 — Historical independent lab (paused): From disc to data

Read the formats without distributing their contents.

Dependencies: M0.

| ID | Feature | Status | Acceptance criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D01 | Read-only ISO reader | Done | ISO 9660 root, SYSTEM.CNF, USA identification and bounds checks. |
| D02 | Disc fingerprint and diagnostics | Paused | Local fingerprints and precise errors for truncated discs or different editions. |
| D03 | Independent FST / AFS contract | Done | Original bounded FST namespace and AFS ordinal contract, synthetic malformed cases, complete retail/prototype ordinal coverage; opaque metadata preserved. |
| D04 | Archive access | Done | Bounded read-only ISO and AFS member windows; rejects invalid ordinals and reads/seeks outside a member. No whole-archive extraction. |
| D05 | Local conversion pipeline | Paused | Private cache versioned by format and invalidated reliably. |
| D06 | Tagged room-container and SCR node metadata | Done | Bounded DAT/SCP tables across 94 retail candidates and 93 nonempty SCP catalogs; SCR signed references and finite raw transforms checked on three samples. Mesh decoding remains separate. |
| D07 | Static MDB and TM3/TIM3 profile | Done | Bounded static flag-zero MDB and observed linear/GS-transfer indexed TIM3 profile; 433 meshes and 158 bank images on three retail candidates. Unsupported variants refused; runtime parity remains open. |

## Outside the public repository

Discs, BIOS files, extracted data, translated game code, dumps and unselected captures stay local.
Selected rendered reference/Bevy screenshots may be published under the [comparison protocol](docs/progress-tracking.md).
See [the independent method](docs/clean-room.md) and [notices](NOTICE.md).
